clauses.title: Scope – Covers the
clauses.text: 1. Scope - Covers the material, dimensions and sectional properties of aluminium I- beam sections for structural use and other applications.

clauses.title: Designation – Aluminium I-
clauses.text: 2. Designation - Aluminium I- beam sections shall be designated as ALB followed  by the depth of section, width of flange in mm and mass in kilograms per metre of the section. Example : ALB 120 x 60 - 4.7

clauses.title: Aluminium sections covered in
clauses.text: 3.1 Aluminium sections covered in this standard shall be manufactured from the following alloys in appropriate temper : 19000, 24345, 24534, 52000, 53000, 54300, 63400, 64423, 64430, 65032 and 74530.

clauses.title: Aluminium alloys and temper
clauses.text: 3.2 Aluminium alloys and temper selected shall conform to the proviions of  IS 733 : 1983+ + Wrought  aluminium and aluminium  alloy, bars, rods and sections for general engineering purposes (third revision) For detailed information, refer  to IS  5384 : 1985  Specifications for aluminium  I-beam (first revision).
